info.name: Recourse
info.description: One folder per phase. Phase 0: every PayPal sandbox call made by scripts/probes (fill client_id, client_secret, buyer_email, operator_email; run "1 Auth / Get access token" first). Phases 1 and 2: the Recourse API at app_base_url (npm run dev). Hand checks: docs/phase1-2-checks.md. Generated by scripts/postman/build.ts.

item.name: Phase 1: Authorization
item.description: Mandates, operators, agents, liability agreement. Needs DATABASE_URL, RECOURSE_SIGNING_KEY and the AI_* settings.

item.name: 1.0 Service
item.description: Start the API with npm run dev. app_base_url defaults to http://localhost:3000.

item.name: 1.1 Mandates
item.description: Compile plain English (LLM) into a strict mandate, approve with PayPal Vault, sign, edit into new versions.

exec: pm.test('size keeps US, men', () => { const s = m.spec.attributes.find(a => a.name === 'size'); pm.expect(s.unit_system).to.eql('US'); pm.expect(s.gender).to.eql('men'); });
pm.test('aggregate budget 120.00 USD', () => pm.expect(m.spec.max_total).to.eql({ value: '120.00', currency: 'USD' }));
